tools.name: list_financing_companies
tools.description: Find saved unregistered equity financing mentions by company name, ticker or CIK.

tools.name: get_financing
tools.description:
Read this CIK's 8-K financing timeline and individual disclosures, filtered by filing date.
        Older filings may be not_evaluated. Preserve amount qualifiers and do not sum repeat mentions.

tools.name: list_leadership_companies
tools.description:
Find saved executive/board disclosures by name, verified ticker or CIK.

        This is a processed subset, not all-market coverage or a current officer roster.

tools.description:

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_timeline" is 1134 chars, far longer than this server's median (162). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
